fieldValues.title: Board labels
fieldValues.meaning: What each status, hold, gate and classification means is the work-status set in the clerk's programme package (decision f58db200); the label text is the programme's `label-binding` records. Today: `ready`, `status: in progress`, `status: in review`, `promote:ready`, `priority: Pn`, `blocked`, `needs-input`, `parked`, `blocks-ranked` (derived: a parked blocker of ranked work; once the programme binds it), `gate:auto-merge`, `gate:owner-merge`, `lane:unattended`, and each group's `wg:*` (from its charter). `intake` is proposed (clerk#56).
